sites.name: Iphrib Khazb, the Works (the old forge)
sites.storm: heavy, still, dusty air; low fog cards and heat shimmer at the platform and works; Geiger peak; the storm is worst here with the valley
sites.story: the Geiger peak is bound here; AMB_V5_WorksInfra; IDLE_MIDDLE_05 "we'll have tea while we wait"
sites.style: BAZAAR STONE + timber + clay: a traditional biofuel forge-works (hand hoist, riveted pipes, clay vats; nothing modern)
sites.layout:
withered shrub ring (nothing grows back inside it)
   feedstock: logs, bales   [FURNACE HALL: tall back gable | furnace hearth under the CHIMNEY STACK] [still room]  clay vessels x5
        dead pulley wheel in its pit     ===== yard lane ===== (hand-cart rails to the hall door)
   foreman's corner: cold fire pit,      [vat plinth: four fermentation vats, one toppled]  hoist   (still, manifold: Tripo)
   table, lamps, the tea pot                spill stain -> down the fall line into the gully (the basin was poisoned this way)
        [gutted store]   slag heaps on the gully lip                    danger board at the track
  ==== the cart track fades out toward the road (58 m) ====
sites.notes: V2 (setdress_v2_groups/outposts_works.py). The hall and the chimney stack are the landmarks CIN_P15_WORKS frames from road 2,260. Tripo slots (optional): copper_still -> T2_biofuel_still, steam_pipe -> T2_pipe_manifold. Optional smoke FX stays off (no one tends a fire here).
